question: Which public name should the project use in its README and operator-facing documentation: retain CLAWDINATOR/clawdinators, or adopt OpenClawtinators?
rationale: This is an identity and documentation-direction choice; the repository evidence does not authorize the proposed rename or define an equivalent mechanical correction.

options.title: Retain CLAWDINATOR
options.body: Close or revise this branch and keep the README aligned with the existing CLAWDINATOR/clawdinators deployment terminology.

options.title: Adopt OpenClawtinators
options.body: Approve the rename explicitly, then update the README and any affected public documentation together in a consistent, reviewed change.

recommendation.title: Retain CLAWDINATOR
recommendation.body: Close or revise this branch and keep the README aligned with the existing CLAWDINATOR/clawdinators deployment terminology.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed rename and are the only identifiable participant connected to this naming change in the supplied evidence.
